products.amazonTitle: The Cable Store 3 Core Fabric Lighting Flex 0.75mm², Red Round, 5m – Braided Electrical Cable for Pendant Lights & Lamps
bullets: 3 CORE FABRIC CABLE, 0.75mm² LIGHTING FLEX – Live, neutral and earth conductors with double PVC insulation, made to H03VV-F (EN 50525-2-11) for wiring pendant, table, floor, wall and ceiling lights.
RED ROUND FABRIC BRAID – A red woven textile sleeve over round cable gives a vintage, industrial look that shows off exposed lamp wiring.
5 METRES IN ONE CONTINUOUS LENGTH – Cut to size for your project; also available in 3, 10, 20 and 50 metre lengths in the same colour.
SUPER FLEXIBLE LAMP CABLE – Curls and coils beautifully, ideal for retro DIY lighting, rewiring old lamps and pairing with Edison filament bulbs and ceiling roses.

TECHNICAL SPEC – 0.75 mm² per core, max temperature +70 °C, max suspended load 3 kg, weight approx. 0.09 kg per metre, outer diameter 6.6 mm, bend radius 24 mm. CE marked, made in the EU, supplied in recyclable packaging.
